a: Arithmetic sequence: each term adds a constant difference.
Geometric sequence: each term multiplies by a constant ratio.
Sum of n terms: n/2 * (first + last).
Binomial coefficient C(n,k) counts ways to choose k from n.
A complex number is a + bi with i² = -1.
Cross product in 3D yields a perpendicular vector.
Transpose flips a matrix over its diagonal.
A^{-1} exists when det(A) ≠ 0 and AA^{-1}=I.
